item.title: Papercut 0.6.0
item.description: <p>Editing: a shared screen shows with the hosts stacked beside it, and on the timeline, in the transcript and in the list. Click the picture to play or pause; jumps and scrubbing are instant and clean.</p><p>In the call, pick which display to share, and see your own shared screen in a tile. Screen recordings keep their true colors.</p><p>Transcripts start a new line after a pause over 2 seconds, and a made-up “TV Gelderland” line is left out. Transcribe Again… on the Processing page brings older recordings up to date.</p><p>Jargon, the words WhisperX should spell your way, is one list for every Mac: Settings → Transcription → Jargon.</p>

item.title: Papercut 0.5.0
item.description:
Recordings go straight between the Macs during the call, replacing the shared folder. Everyone in the room needs this version.

Listeners are recorded by sound (their microphone, never their camera) and combined with the hosts.

Everyone has a three-letter ID and a full name: pick yours in Settings → You.

A Tasks page (⌘4) shows what runs in the background; quitting waits for what would be lost.

Editing: paste the lines a language model kept into the Edit box, and Make Edit… cuts them into a video. The player shows the time of day.

The call keeps itself alive, and the Audio section sets input and output with their volumes.

item.title: Papercut 0.4.0
item.description:
Updates itself from now on: Papercut checks once a day, or right away with Papercut → Check for Updates…

Screen sharing in the call, recorded locally and placed in the combined file.

Listeners, the assistant (OpenRouter too), and Export text on the Processing page.
